changelog:
- Initial release of getpost-email skill.
- Instantly create and use a functional email address via API—no server setup required.
- Send and receive emails using simple authenticated API calls.
- Features include inbox retrieval, sending emails, dedicated address registration, webhook support, and optional custom domain setup.
- See full API documentation for details: https://getpost.dev/docs/api-reference#email
summary: Send and receive emails via API. Get a working email address instantly.
